# Benchmark

Generated by `npx tsx bench/run.mts` on 2026-11-19 · Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125U · Node v26.13.1 · win32

Dataset: 144 synthetic 1280×720 camera frames (perspective ±12 %, any rotation, Gaussian defocus σ∈{0,0.8,1.5}, noise σ=5, illumination gradient, high/low contrast, short URL + long EMV/LaoQR payload) + 8 frames without a code. Every decoder sees identical pixels. A hit = exact text match.

## Decode rate by module size (px per QR module)

| engine | 1.5 px | 2 px | 2.5 px | 3 px | 4 px | 6 px | **all** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| jsQR | 0% | 25% | 25% | 46% | 67% | 88% | **42%** |
| ZXing-C++ (WASM) | 4% | 38% | 63% | 67% | 96% | 100% | **61%** |
| kpay (ZXing + locator + ROI) | 8% | 42% | 63% | 67% | 96% | 100% | **63%** |
| kpay + WeChat SR (JS) | 13% | 42% | 63% | 67% | 96% | 100% | **63%** |
| kpay + WeChat SR (ONNX Runtime) | 17% | 42% | 63% | 67% | 96% | 100% | **64%** |
| WeChat (OpenCV C++, 1 thr) | 29% | 42% | 50% | 63% | 88% | 100% | **62%** |
| WeChat (OpenCV C++, 14 thr) | 29% | 42% | 50% | 63% | 88% | 100% | **62%** |
